# Showcase Dark Elf Spider Swarm — darkelf — 576 points

*v1999.12.0*

## Roboprosthetic Dark Elf (6×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 4x Roboprosthetic Dark Elf
- Type: Bio, Infantry, Walking, Roboprosthetic
- Armor: 3/3/3/3
- Points: 48
- Shaken: slow [-, -, Flee] / Can't use weapons

- **To Hit**: Take Cover[Still][-2]; Take Cover[Crawl][-2]; Camouflage[Swamp]
- **Hidden**: Unit starts with a Hidden token
- **Forward Position**: [1]

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 0-5 | Kill 1 model |
| 6-8 | Kill 1 model, d6 Psychic damage |
| 9 | Destroy unit |
- When one model is killed, half all +1 to future damage rounded down
- If killed by poison, remove that instance

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 5+ | Unit shaken |


### Roboprosthetic Dark Elf

- Equipment: 1x SMG, 1x Hide
- Assault: strength 1/1/1/1 (5+), deflection 1/1/0/0 (6+), damage d6-2, AP 2


- **Cunning Assault**: [2]
- **Penalty**: Reroll all success in assault while crawling

#### SMG

- Range: 3, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6-3, AP 1
- **Ammo**: Always treated as loaded
- **Multiple Shots**: Fires two times each time it is fired


---

## Mechanical Assault Spider (6×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 1x Mechanical Assault Spider
- Type: Mechanical, Walking, Drone
- Armor: 7/7/7/7
- Points: 48
- Shaken: still [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons


**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-2 | +1 to future damage |
| 3 | as below, shaken |
| 4-6 | as below, critical damage[d6] |
| 7+ | Destroy unit |

**Damage Table: Critical**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1 | -1 to-hit, +1 to-be-hit (ranged and assault) |
| 2 | Cannot move |
| 3 | Cannot rotate |
| 4 | x3 +3 to future damage |
| 5 | half, rounded down, all assault strength and deflection values |
| 6 | Unit set on Fire |


### Mechanical Assault Spider

- Equipment: 1x Head Gun
- Assault: strength 6/4/2/1 (5+), deflection 6/2/0/0 (6+), damage d6, AP 7

- **To Hit**: Good Shot

- **Assault Extra Damage**: Poison[6][1 for 2]

#### Head Gun

- Range: 3, angle True/True/False/False, damage d6, AP 6
- **Range Extra Damage**: Poison[6]
